# SoftSpark dsh-process-console

> Browser-only DeepSeek Harness bundle adding a Processes tab: every agent and subagent of a conversation as a live console with paired tool requests and responses.

## Primary files

- README.md: what the tab shows, install, update, external delegations.
- cordis.patch.yml: the single inserted loader row naming the package root.
- src/client/index.tsx: registers the tab in the `conversation.view` slot and the `subagent/stream` fold.
- src/client/console-lines.ts: pure fold from a conversation snapshot to console lines.
- src/client/process-source.ts: the one reactive fact, which child window is selected.
- kb/reference/architecture.md: slot, data path, why the package is standalone.
- kb/reference/security.md: read-only surface, no host half.
- kb/reference/subagent-stream.md: the harness-side change behind delegation rows.
- kb/reference/upstream-proposal.md: the text proposed to the harness maintainers.
- kb/decisions/: architecture decision records.
- kb/procedures/: pre-commit, release, and post-release SOPs.
- patches/dsh-0.1.1-rc.2/: source patch and per-package lib patches for the harness change.

## Hard constraints

- Version 2 targets DSH 0.1.2-rc.1; every @deepseek-ai peer exact. Version 1.0.0 remains the historical 0.1.1-rc.2 artifact.
- The browser loader permits React plus the public Session Controller and Conversation constructor entries (ADR-003); other harness imports are type-only.
- Read-only: no prompt, cancel, rename, command or queue writes.
- No host service, no Remote, no lifecycle scripts.
- Public object layer only: Session Controller, Conversation and Trajectory targets, pending interactions, framework hooks.
- Delegation rows need the subagent/stream patch set on the harness; without it the tab shows delegations as CALL/RESULT in the parent.

## Verified evidence

- 1.0.0 registry installation and SLSA v1 provenance were checked on 2026-09-06. Its live browser checks were source-workbench checks, not complete registry-artifact verification.
- Live in dsh-drydock 1.27.0: three tabs, a nested Claude Code delegation row with its own console including an MCP response.
